distribution.integrity: CI validates every Skill source and AgentTeams binding against this manifest.

skills.name: repository-triage
skills.invocationConditions: Exactly once at run start and again only after evidence-backed replanning.
skills.failureHandling: Record error evidence and stop or create a clarification task instead of guessing.
skills.permissions: Read-only planning; no source or GitHub mutation.

skills.name: root-cause-localization
skills.invocationConditions: After a valid triage task and again only when new evidence invalidates the cause.
skills.failureHandling: Preserve exact errors, characterize flakiness, and return blocked when evidence is insufficient.

skills.name: safe-patch-authoring
skills.invocationConditions: Only after evidence confirms a root cause.
skills.failureHandling: Stop on scope expansion and preserve local commit plus external-write errors.
skills.permissions: May create a branch, commit, push, and PR; cannot merge, force-push, or change permissions.

skills.name: verification-gate
skills.invocationConditions: After each new patch commit SHA.
skills.failureHandling: Separate pre-existing failures, record retries, and block while CI or evidence is incomplete.
skills.permissions: Read-only verification; cannot modify or merge the patch.

skills.name: runbook-archival
skills.invocationConditions: After a final PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED verification outcome.
skills.failureHandling: Return the complete Runbook as a deliverable when storage is unavailable.
skills.permissions: No repository code mutation; may create or update only the run-scoped Proof Comment on the target PR; redact secrets and personal data.
verification: Proof Comment publishes score and chain head without raw evidence payloads
